items.title: Post-close COMPLETED-BAR CONFIRMATION: a new 08-03 daily bar forms (frontier advances 07-31 -> 08-03) so persistence INCREMENTS, while the pre-close expected-move / IV bump RENORMALIZES back down even as dealer net-gamma keeps decaying across all three same-day windows and a below-threshold Double top flips to a qualified Double bottom.
items.note: Genuinely new versus the prior same-day 'frozen-frontier round-trip + band-widening' pattern (which explicitly did NOT increment persistence). Between the pre-close and after-hours windows of the SAME calendar day (meta.todayEt unchanged 2026-08-03, marketClosed=false, nextSessionDate 2026-08-04) the completed-daily-bar frontier ADVANCED from 2026-07-31 to 2026-08-03 (swing bars 506 -> 507; dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate 2026-07-31 -> 2026-08-03; 287/287 fresh, 0 carried, 0 missing), so the XLY rotate-into gains a THIRD distinct completed bar date (07-30, 07-31, 08-03) and persistence INCREMENTS to a low-conviction persistent state. Simultaneously the SPY dealer-gamma expected-move / IV bump RENORMALIZED: atmIV 14.46% -> 11.85% and expected move ±4.06 -> ±3.32 (both back to the morning level) while signedNetGEX kept EASING monotonically across all three windows (+6.439B morning -> +5.209B pre-close -> +3.150B after-hours), the flip ticked 742.54 -> 744.32 and the wall band held 740/760 (span 20). The swing pattern flipped from a below-threshold Double top (pre-close) to a pattern-qualified Double bottom on the fresh 08-03 bar, breadth improved 48.64% -> 57.53% (still narrow, below 60%), the vol-sizing forecast rose 13.9101% -> 14.5644% (throttle ×1.08 -> ×1.03) and SPY held its fresh 52-week high (pctFrom52wHigh 0, px 757.76 -> 757.67, VIX 15.79 -> 15.86 band 'VIX 15.9'). Signature: a same-day window that CLOSES the session both advances the completed-bar frontier (persistence can and does increment) AND mean-reverts the intraday IV/expected-move bump — the opposite of the frozen-frontier reprice — even while structural dealer net-gamma keeps decaying.
items.method: Add a 'post-close completed-bar confirmation' composite test that fires when snapshot.window advances within the SAME meta.todayEt (pre-close -> after-hours) AND marketClosed=false AND dataFreshness.bars.expectedSessionDate ADVANCES to a NEW date (07-31 -> 08-03) with freshSymbolCount==symbolCount AND carriedSymbolCount==0 AND missingSymbolCount==0 AND the swing bar count increments by exactly 1. Trigger on FOUR joint conditions: (1) FRONTIER ADVANCE = expectedSessionDate changes to a new completed date within the same calendar day and swing bars +1, so a rotation into-leg that repeats on the new bar INCREMENTS its distinct-completed-bar-date persistence counter (opposite of the frozen-frontier reprice, which must not increment); (2) IV/EM RENORMALIZATION = options-structure atmIV and expectedMove fall back toward the morning baseline versus the pre-close bump (14.46% -> 11.85%, ±4.06 -> ±3.32) while the wall span is unchanged; (3) MONOTONE NET-GEX DECAY = signedNetGEX declines across all three same-day windows (+6.439B -> +5.209B -> +3.150B) even as the pin holds and the flip drifts up (742.54 -> 744.32); (4) STRUCTURE-STATE FLIP = swing patternState moves from below-threshold to pattern-qualified with a pattern label change (Double top -> Double bottom) on the fresh bar. Emit an experimental flag only when (1) holds AND at least two of (2)-(4) co-occur, so the pattern is distinguished from an ordinary end-of-day bar close.
